_comment: Per-field credential resolution config for tools/expressionengine. Consumed by resolveCredential() once tools/lib/resolve-credential.cjs ships; until then, lib/ee-auth.js resolves credentials itself via the same four-source order (env -> 1Password service-account -> 1Password ambient session -> error).

url.note: Resolved from the 1Password item's top-level .urls array, not a named field.
